title: cartesianMesh Error Visibility & analyze_error() Enhancement
goal: Improve cartesianMesh error diagnostics: fix false matches in analyze_error(), expose full log to user, and generate problem-specific error messages.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: analyze_error() no longer falsely matches on generic words "error"/"fatal" — only real cfMesh/FOAM patterns
AC2: analyze_error() detects signal crashes (SIGFPE, SIGSEGV) as ErrorType.CRASH
AC3: analyze_error() detects "non-mappable patch" and "boundary file not found" as new ErrorTypes
AC4: QualityPanel shows a "Show Log" button that opens a dialog with the full cartesianMesh raw output
AC5: Raw cartesianMesh output is always saved to log.meshing and accessible via Show Log button
AC6: Error messages shown to user contain the actual error line(s), not the generic "cartesianMesh reported a fatal error"

changes.detail: Replace generic UNKNOWN with specific error types. New enum: NONE, NON_WATERTIGHT, SURFACE_READ, PATCH_NOT_FOUND, FOAM_FATAL, CRASH, NON_MAPPABLE, BOUNDARY_NOT_FOUND

1. REMOVE the generic catch-all "if \"fatal\" in lo or \"error\" in lo" at line 65
2. Add specific patterns in order:
   - r"--> FOAM FATAL ERROR:" -> ErrorType.FOAM_FATAL
   - r"FOAM FATAL" -> ErrorType.FOAM_FATAL
   - r"Floating point exception" -> ErrorType.CRASH
   - r"Segmentation fault" -> ErrorType.CRASH
   - r"non-mappable" -> ErrorType.NON_MAPPABLE
   - r"boundary file not found|Cannot find boundary file" -> ErrorType.BOUNDARY_NOT_FOUND
3. Keep existing patterns (non-watertight, self-intersect, cannot read, cannot find file, cannot find patch, unknown patch)
4. For FOAM_FATAL and CRASH: extract first 1-3 meaningful error lines after the marker into ErrorInfo.detail
5. For all ErrorTypes: set message to a human-readable specific string, suggestion to actionable advice

changes.action: improve log messages and add detail emission
changes.detail:
After analyze_error(), if error.error_type != NONE:
   - emit self._on_log with f"[error] {error.message}" (already exists)
   - ADD: if error.detail, emit self._on_log with f"[error-detail] {error.detail}"
If error_type == NONE but exit_code != 0:
   - emit self._on_log with "[error] cartesianMesh exit code X without recognized error pattern. Click Show Log to inspect."

changes.action: add "Show Log" button and log viewer dialog
changes.detail:
1. Add QPushButton "Show Log" to the bottom row layout
2. Store self._raw_log: str = ""
3. Add method set_raw_log(text: str) to set content
4. On button click, open QualityLogDialog:
   - QDialog containing QPlainTextEdit (read-only, monospace font: Consolas, Courier New)
   - Display self._raw_log content
   - "Close" button
   - "Copy All" button
   - Size: 800x600
5. Add clear_raw_log() method called in clear_report()

changes.action: pass raw output to QualityPanel and improve messages
changes.detail:
1. Call self._quality.set_raw_log(output) immediately after analyze_error()
2. Also call it on success path for post-mortem inspection
3. Improve error messages to include specific detail:
   - If error.error_type != NONE: show error.message + error.detail
   - If exit_code != 0 and error_type == NONE: show specific message about unknown error + instruct to click Show Log
4. The self._status.showMessage should reflect the specific error, not just "Meshing failed"

error_type_mapping_new.PATCH_NOT_FOUND: patch in meshDict not found in STL (existing)
error_type_mapping_new.FOAM_FATAL: --> FOAM FATAL ERROR: with extracted error line (NEW)

risks: Show Log dialog may contain very long output — QPlainTextEdit handles this natively with line limits
Extracting error lines after FOAM FATAL marker may fail if format changes — fallback to exit code + generic message
ErrorType enum change may break comparison in main_window._make_fix_action() — verify all references
